purpose: Teach: 山崎/藤原/松井/青山/坂本/近藤/石井/中島

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスのメンバー、山崎さんは委員長、藤原さんは副委員長。
lines.en: In our class — Yamazaki's the class rep, Fujiwara's vice.
lines.style: Quick, efficient delivery. Slight breathy enthusiasm on the opening. Ticking off details like she's painting a picture. Matter-of-fact but engaged.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 松井、青山、二人とも体育会系で頼れる。
lines.en: Matsui and Aoyama — both athletic, dependable types.
lines.style: Low, half-interested tone. Nodding along. The voice of someone acknowledging what he already knows. Steady pace, no push.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 坂本さんが文化祭の主役。近藤さんが舞台美術。
lines.en: Sakamoto's leading the culture festival. Kondo's handling stagecraft.
lines.style: Bright, forward-moving delivery. Light emphasis on 「leading」 — she can see it working already. Quick pace, almost automatic.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 石井先生、新しく担任になったよな。
lines.en: Ishii-sensei just became our homeroom teacher.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Slight pause before the name — registering the change. Thoughtful rather than gossipy. Measured exhale at the close.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 中島さんは、放送部の編集が得意らしい。
lines.en: Nakajima-san apparently has a real knack for broadcast-club editing.
lines.style: Leaning in slightly. Warm curiosity beneath the words. Phrased as discovery — she's learned this about someone, and it matters. Soft fade on the detail.
